chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Four things are from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers: applying fragrance, the siwak (toothstick), women, and henna."

key_terms.السِّوَاكُ: using the toothstick for oral cleaning
key_terms.النِّسَاءُ: women, referring here to marital relations

ai.seo_question: What practices are considered from the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers in this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) states that four practices belong to the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the messengers. The hadith highlights personal grooming, cleanliness, marital life, and adornment as established prophetic practices.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.111 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Four practices are from the traditions of the messengers: applying fragrance, using siwak (toothstick), having relations with women, and using henna."
